title: StorageManifest
description: The manifest of the storage root (dashql-manifest.json) with the app settings and the connections. The workbooks are registered in the workbook tree, see app_folder.json.

storageVersion.description: The version of the storage, absent before storage versions existed (version 1). The app migrates older versions at startup, see packages/dashql-app/src/storage/migration, and refuses newer ones.

connections.description: The connections, the source of truth for the connection settings that workbooks replicate. Absent in manifests written before connections were global, an empty array means there are no connections.

ConnectionEntry.description: A connection that workbooks reference by its id

id.description: The connection identifier (UUID), workbooks reference the connection with it

params.description: The saved connection parameters, every workbook referencing the connection stores a copy

paramsDraft.description: Unsaved edits of the connection parameters, including incomplete or invalid settings. Never replicated into workbooks.

name.description: The name the user gave the connection, absent for the default label

cacheQueryResults.description: Whether query results of the connection are cached and reused for unchanged scripts. Absent for the default of the connector.

cloudConnectionId.description: The connection that the user logs in to when the app starts, new workbooks start on it and published workbooks are stored in its tables

flavor.description: The id of the app flavor, the flavor query parameter of the url wins

agentEnabled.description: Is the agent on? Then agents may read, edit and run the scripts of the visible workbook through the local agent server, never those of another workbook

agentPort.description: The port of the local agent server, the build's default if unset
